blind.description: A long, elegant banquet or conference table with a rounded rectangular top featuring a light-toned inlaid border trim. The tabletop rests on three turned pedestal supports, each branching into four carved splayed feet with brass or gold-painted toe caps. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with polished dark reddish-brown wood texturing. It stands stably directly on its pedestal feet without any extra plinth or slab.
blind.from_above: An elongated rounded rectangle (capsule/stadium-like with flat sides) showing polished dark wood grain bordered by an inset gold or lighter wood inlay band.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches approximately waist-to-mid-hip height on the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 ft tall); length spans roughly 1.5 times the figure's height (around 8 to 9 ft long).
